# Husain Bardanwala

> Software engineer and intelligent systems builder based in India. Builds full-stack
> products and AI-enabled systems. Four project case studies and one data study are
> documented with constraints, decisions and trade-offs, each verified against its
> public source repository.

## Pages

- [Home](https://port-folio-lilac-pi.vercel.app/): Positioning, selected work, and contact.
- [Selected Work](https://port-folio-lilac-pi.vercel.app/work): Index of all case studies.
- [IdeaBridge](https://port-folio-lilac-pi.vercel.app/work/ideabridge): AI-powered startup validation platform — React SPA with an Express analysis API.
- [Healthcare Appointment System](https://port-folio-lilac-pi.vercel.app/work/healthcare-appointment-system): Java CLI appointment manager with per-doctor FIFO queues.
- [iEMS](https://port-folio-lilac-pi.vercel.app/work/iems): Integrated Education Management System, built as team lead at CVMU Hackathon 4.0.
- [BuildEx Website](https://port-folio-lilac-pi.vercel.app/work/buildex-website): Official club website for BuildEx, SVIT Vasad.
- [IPL Analysis](https://port-folio-lilac-pi.vercel.app/work/ipl-analysis): Data study of 1,095 IPL matches — whether winning the toss predicts winning the match.
- [Engineering](https://port-folio-lilac-pi.vercel.app/engineering): How Husain thinks about problems, the build process, and the full toolkit.
- [About](https://port-folio-lilac-pi.vercel.app/about): Background, education, and the dated path from first build to team lead.
- [Contact](https://port-folio-lilac-pi.vercel.app/contact): Email and social links.
